purpose: Additive source-backed #359 reassessment questions. Frozen32 and existing157 challenges are unchanged; lexical route hits require separate expected-fact review.

questions.query: Which four liquid solver families are selectable on current main for Water, Brine and the other liquids, and are pressure variants separate families?
facts: Water admits FreeMass/reference, CellularYield/reference, PressureFlow/reference/cached/cached_dormant and InertialCellular/reference.
Brine admits CY/reference and IN/reference; the other nine liquids admit CY/reference only. ToxicSludge IN has no qualified variant.
Each material has one immutable applied family per World; pressure variants are one family and production defaults remain unchanged.

questions.query: Can ordinary Liquid comparison and shared PLAY select all four Water laws and rebuild real native Rapier sessions, and what acceptance remains?
facts: The eight-preset panel and shared PLAY selector construct real native Worlds with explicit geometry and normalization; App #256 and Trial #257 are merged.
LIFE011 covers eight presets and five mechanical rigs, including terrain and lifecycle, not completed fair scientific or human comparison.
The panel exposes two protected setups; native-default PF capacity refusal and separate full-host/Web/manual limits remain explicit.

questions.query: Do inertial leak and bottom-drain bubbles simulate gas pressure, does Rapier impact inject liquid momentum, and can IN make upward ballistic spray?
facts: IN retains motion and can leave vacant cells, but has no gas-pressure or buoyancy operator. The remembered scene still needs registered reproduction.
Downward-positive vy is constrained to 0..32; negative vy is refused and genuine upward ballistic IN momentum is unsupported.
Body overlap relocation carries existing IN state without injecting impact velocity; projectile velocity is separate from deposited liquid state.

questions.query: How much dense IN memory does a 1024 squared resident World require and does matching its physical hash prove all saved ledgers match?
facts: A shared six-byte array covers every resident cell when IN is enabled, including Empty; 1024 squared slots require 6,291,456 bytes before other memory.
IN uses hash3/CYPS3 and non-IN uses2; CYPS persists extra diagnostic ledgers not covered by physical hash.
Compare IN/pressure ledgers independently; array/component cost is not total host RSS.

questions.query: Does four configured native workers prove four simultaneous participants, and which PLAY observations measure jobs and full gameplay cost?
facts: worker_threads_observed is maximum distinct task claimants in one phase, not configured workers or simultaneous overlap.
Brine boundary evidence explicitly requires four claimants; Water tests require more than one. SerialInPlace zero is unmeasured, while phased inline may report one.
Existing 4Hz PLAY samples need comparison export; native tick, preparation, Rapier, publication and frame pacing are separate costs. No four-family gameplay FPS result follows.

questions.query: How should radius three IN, radius two FreeMass, whole-cell normalization and pressure overfill be handled in fair comparison without rewriting protected LCB fixtures?
facts: Use separate Worlds with shared seed, geometry, precision and action schedule; matched radius3 and preferred radius2 non-IN/radius3 IN are separately labelled lanes.
Explicit initial normalization records quantity changes and cannot legalize future fractional drips/trickle/thin-stream inputs.
Census PF overfill and gas state; compare cache/dormancy to pressure reference. Keep27 protected/default catalogue results and117 historical arm classifications unchanged.

questions.query: What existing observation and scientific PRs should LCB-FEEL reuse and how can leaks, contact and PLAY work proceed without conflicting owners?
facts: Reconcile #258 unique copied IN ledger/availability and #259 Godot-prepared CYPS/native full-resident scientific consumer, rather than duplicating them. Both remain unmerged.
Existing PLAY can provide the common host; #260 actor retention is optional and #261 historical pending statuses are not current CI truth.

One owner integrates shared Main/worker/readback changes; coordinate structural/contact work with #347 and pacing/recovery/diagnostics with #304 and the PACE004 apparatus merged by #334. #363 consumes evidence without automatic defaults or merges.

questions.query: What does the latest pressure cached and dormant timing evidence prove about performance and actual worker participation?
facts: Packed-source c97f68ec measured complete native tick cost on Windows; awake workloads improved while some churn/fallback cases regressed.
Actual task participation depends on workload; small fixtures may use only one despite configured four.
The source-bound results do not establish universal speedup, Rapier host cost, gameplay frame rate or a preferred liquid family.
